items.title: FactSet Research Systems (FDS) Brings 60 Plus Alternative Data Providers Into Client Workflows
items.summary: FactSet Research Systems (NYSE:FDS) has partnered with Carbon Arc to integrate data from over 60 alternative data providers into its platforms. The collaboration will bring these external data sources directly into FactSet Workstation and its AI ecosystem for institutional clients. Carbon Arc is expected to act as an aggregation layer, standardising third party datasets for use across FactSet workflows.
